message:
Add VDF files for 6 missing gamepad types.
Update gamepad manifest.

Keep sound template AudioSources enabled while pooled, disabling them on every recycle flushed unity's audio DSP, stalling up to ~1ms when a sound got cut mid play

RecycleSound in editor:
~0.45ms -> ~0.25ms
The occasional 1ms "flush dsp connections" is gone
Fix SelectedBlueprint.CanCraft running every frame while the crafting menu is closed, small but unnecessary
scrap king building skin steam item setup

Add support for major/minor revision bumping.
Update all gamepad configs with this data.
Update validation to always check/catch chamges.
Fix all skinned items allocating on every inventory update when getting their icon sprite

Attack/AttackAlt are now Button actions on the triggers' soft pull so players can rebind fire/aim to any button (per Valve guidance).
Update all action sets/configs to match,
Stop any rumble in Deactivate
remove the Rust Render Pipeline text when RRP is enabled, instead show Built-In Render Pipeline when RRP is disabled
Try/catch the gamepad update loop, disable on any error errors.

Fixed quick craft spending ~1.6ms rebuilding after almost every shot (inventory update)
Only rebuilds when the inventory is open now
fix stale frame on subsystems without fade in, fix flare not having a predict release event, remove fade in on flare subsystem to fix weird flipping artifact on flare
Update comment
Get rid of some debug logs spamming related to halloween dungeon spawning
Re-add the "Restoring X/100,000 links" for cases where the cache links aren't used
fix RRP drawing ocean after water bodies

Halloween stringlights
Improve deployment, stop clipping, fix groundwatch, reduce network range, remove snapping
All tests pass

Pool 3 copies of thrown melee weapon and tool projectiles instead of 100. No point in filling our pool with 3900 copies you'll rarely see more than 3 of at the same time

Saves around 50MB of memory and gives me some leeway to eat that with gun effects next

Pass `serverStartup` parameter into RestoringLoadedEntityLinks() so we don't call RCON.Update() when pasting with copypaste
- probably harmless but it bugged me
Increase stick move distance required to activate gamepad
Codegen
Codegen

Remove three unused floats (skincol, skintex, skinmesh) from all player net messages that havent been used since 2016
Defaults were set to -1 so included in the proto

Saves 17 bytes per player

Optimize server startup time by caching the ocean patrol path on disk (158s -> 138s)
- same idea as server occlusion grid being saved
- can increase version number to regenerate next restart
- convar `regenerate_ocean_path` will cause it to regenerate it next startup too
Prewarm 5 copies of each ricochet effect instead of 1, first magazine dumped after connecting created up to 2 more per prefab at ~0.5ms each

Stop networking IO wire origin data and duplicate slack levels to clients
Saves ~34 B per wired slot + ~5 B per wire point on network load

Fix flame turret sending two updates per trigger change instead of one

Saves 60 B~ per nearby player each time the turret turns on or off
Update test list

Stop water purifier sending two unchanged network updates per boil tick

30 B/s~ per nearby player

Dont send environment rainGraceStartTicks (only used on the server)
Sends every 5 seconds.

54 → 44 B per update, so saves 10 B~ every per player every 5s

Door.SetOpen no longer sends a full network update when the door is already in the requested state (door closers re-close shut doors 3 s after every open/close cycle)

Saves ~76 B per nearby player per call
Only send search light network updates when aim/flags change rather than per tick when mounted

Dont send travelling vendor map marker updates 20 frames a second

Saves 160 bytes per network tick when the vendor is out
~ merge from optimize_enforce_limits -> main
Create the pools LaunchProjectileClientside uses at bootstrap instead of on the first shot, avoids a ~365KB alloc when the first projectile of the session is fired

Remove old mortar prototype code
Means we can remove an mortarCooldown float with every BasePlayer update

Saves 6 bytes per player update

Reduce number of unique keys set to prolong time until limit is hit
- round entities to nearest 1000
- round FPS to nearest whole number (and clamp to 512)
- round RAM to nearest 100MB
- round GC count to 2 significant figures (1-9,10-90,100-900,etc)
- round uptime to nearest 15m interval instead of every 30s
- increases time before limit is hit from 7d -> 365d+

Prevent server from crashing if too many keys are set
- stop setting new keys after 50k unique values have been set (it can still assign to previous values)
- prevents server from getting enough unique values to cause the crash
Compile fix, missed a file..

Add a test to ensure that networkLookDirection is false for NPCs that dont have a look animator
Better way to go than toggling in preprocess
Fixed 150531 not working in builds (Mega hack to bypass the PlayerUpdateCanvases call when unity renders the realtime cubemap, saving some time wasted on UI for nothing)

Fix the editor freezing for like 5s when you first die
This was due to us loading the prefab for pretty much every item that can kill you when you die in editor. This load happens at preprocess in builds
Add PrefabInformation to some deployed thrown weapons so they still display correctly in the death screen

Dont send full network updates every tick for for animals without a look animator.
bears, polar bears, boars, chickens, crabs, frogs, jellyfish, squirrels, rabbits, stags

Worst offender is bear costing 94 bytes~ per update when roaming.


~550 B/s → ~27 B/s per bear per player while roaming
mesh and model tweaks
Restore update order just to be safe

Fix error spam from scarecrows
Fix bug that made scarecrows, gingerbread npcs, and junkpile scientists float slightly above the ground
Revert ProjectSettings.asset changes

material updates post shader changes
crowflock prefab uses single emitter now
Add particle stream toggle to crittermovement shader so mesh particles get a per-particle flap
Fixed sounds started by destroyed monument client entities when loading not being cleared correctly
Cache an invoke

Material fixes
Added test flock prefab

Fix gesture duration
Add more sound events for sheep foot stomp and cow head shake
Improve facing the player
Crow model/materials
Fix main menu not rendering sometimes
Another order fix/improvement

Sound occlusion optims:
- stop checking every wall between a sound and the camera once one wall muffles it
- looping sounds occlusion rays are batched
- virtualised sounds (sounds muted by unity) check occlusion every 1s instead of 0.25s

Standing outside an average base with 40 looping sounds in range:
~0.65ms -> ~0.05 ms per frame
Gamepad building hints order optim fix
Scratch animation re-export at origin
pt_boat_target_fixes -> main
Pie menu optim
compile fix
Hidden players rank behind every visible one, but can still be picked if nobody is visible
Fix bug causing PT boats to sometimes easily give up on targets up to 12 units above sea level. It should've been only 12 units below sea level
anim setup updates

Reapply stomped code changes
Hook up petting react animations for cows and sheep
Add moo and baa sound events
Setup scratch gesture 1st / 3rd person (viewmodel doesnt work yet as it has an offset baked in)

moved pipe mesh generation to use the MeshData native interfaces, including port of tangent calculation
- virtually 0 main-thread cost now, almost all of the work is done on job threads
mag_drop_fixes -> main

- All magazine drops now land on the ground for a little while
- Add some random angular velocity to the magazine as its removed. Ensures mags dont land bolt upright
Add SetVehicleLoad and slightly retune vehicle haptics while I'm at it
More specific vehicle seat check for haptics

Rename some cursor/inventory UI options to be more clear.
Play pick/drop inventory sounds when using virtual gamepad selection
Swap the rest of the mag drops over to the same system as the glass ak
Fix lasers being broken in first person

pre-initialize found bones array with the extra bones that have already been moved as part of DoBoneRetargeting to avoid pointlessly recursive searching for them
- much more impactful for things like hazmat skins that have a lot of extra bones for skirts
- ~0.3ms now for BoneRetarget
fixed missing upkeep component for triangle spiral stairs
Debug overlay only created on demand when gamepad_debug_overlay is true

Remove the cachedPostIK system - its not needed after spine IK has been moved into jobs
- Cleanup mag drops
Don't calculate/trigger haptics/rumble if gamepad not current input device
Ignore all pad stick input when not the current input device used for play, fixes potential stick drift causing input for m/k play
Fixed item stup for halloween DLC, (halloween lights not being craftable, having different stack size and crafting cost to xmas lights, and alien suit blocking torso instead of legs)
revert accidental cloth asset change

optim bone retarget, cache the found bones on the first lod's search so following lods can just read the cache directly
~6.5ms -> ~1ms
Rework gamepad duck-latching so it only touches gamepad logic, fixes potential escape menu not clearing input.
Increased the arctic biome threshold for refrigeration to 10%, should prevent refrigeration happening in strange places with little specks of invisible arctic

Rail segments now cook their collider mesh in a job instead of on the main thread
5.2ms -> 0.03ms on the main thread per segment

- Add badges to DLC
- Show badge on dlc bound items in the character creator
- Add crappy sunburn badge

Standardise milk skimming and food spoiling - skimming used to require a powered fridge even in the arctic
Skimming timer will now increase any time an item is refrigerated, either via the environment or a fridge
Add per prefab timings to the dumpWarmup console command, measures how long each prefab takes to warm up
square steam images for halloween sitems
Fix alignment
Flail vm and 3p set up with placeholder animations
store icons for halloween limited items, plus set all to limited
Fix compile
Comment
Fixed regression with player boat privs when using the cache
Cleaned up building priv cache vs vis tests

Neon sign sounds are now occluded
Had to adjust their volume slightly
Fixed attached explosives getting scaled incorrectly on the solar panel
Fixed incorrect material replacement when using the spraycan to reskin the double door at low quality
Fixed chainlink gate speed opening 2x slower
Cleanup

NPC mount points can now specify a size and overlaps - so a large mount point could overlap other mount points and make them inaccessible
Added a new, single large mount point to the 2 module flatbed that overlaps the two existing small mount points
Prevents being able to mount two cows to large flatbed, still allows two sheep to be loaded

Fixed error spam on ultra-wide screens with the nailgun, paintball gun and bowless crossbow viewmodels. Small rounding errors in the viewmodel sway/bob were snowballing each frame until Unity rejected the rotation. No visual change, just trying for a clean console.
Possibly fixed terrain configs not loading in a demo
Cleanup
Reordered the check so bases with no TC are cheaper
Convared the vehicle and entity privilege changes under buildingmanager.privilegecache
Building privilege tests

Legacy shelters, vehicles and boat building stations no longer use Vis queries

Same base same spot:
GetVehicleBuildingPrivilege 0.34ms -> 0.01ms
GetEntityBuildingPrivilege 0.84ms -> ~0
nailgun skinnable initial setup
Optimize server startup time by 72s (230s -> 158s) by fetching the spawnables only once instead of doing it for each of the 100 spawn populations
Optimize server startup time by 24s (254s -> 230s) by using HashSet to check for duplicate player models
Added coconuts to small_a, small_b, small_c and med_a
Sort the cells oldest first

Store each blocks bound centre and net id in the grid so:
- blocks out of the query radius are skipped without a dictionary lookup
- the age check doesnt read every block from memory
Only run HasColliderWithinSphere when the block bounds aren't entirely inside the search sphere

Around 0.09ms for GetBuildingPrivilege in that same base, same spot
LightGroupAtTime optimization pass
Fix regression caught by Led_TwoInSingleFile_StandSideBySide test

- Skip the bounds check for blocks that aren't older than the current best block
- Visit the cell you're standing in first

Skips a lot of work when standing in the core or middle of a base
On livestock, stop using syncvars for things that should not be broadcasted to all clients, instead use protobuf
Created a coconut lootspawn and additional prefab. Added to palm_tree_tropical_small_b for testing

Attempt at global building privilege cache, using a simple grid holding all the building blocks + a collider test on the winning block, because triangles and roofs have bounds larger than their colliders
Thats enough to remove the Vis Entities call and keep the same precision. Works on the client and the server

In a big base, 575 blocks around me:
4.60ms -> ~0.50ms

Fix livestock not using trough when any grass is present, after current overgrazing rework
Now eat less food the more grass there is in the pen, but still eats food, and grass only is less filling
Fix test attribute

Enabled dropAtExactPosition on the beehive.natural
Apples have a 15% chance to spawn on oak_d and oak_f (we want apple trees to be rare)

Added a way for apples to spawn in the exact location their loot container is on the trees.
Before:
https://files.facepunch.com/lukester/2026/October/10_18-53-GlassGallowaycow.mp4
Now:
https://files.facepunch.com/lukester/2026/October/10_18-48-TimelyBaboon.mp4
Tests

Add global const for "entity_links" version so we can invalidate all entity links when needed

Cache entity links across server restarts
- if a prefab's sockets change since it was saved it will relink sockets
- works for copy paste (so we can see how things were linked on a remote server)
fix laserbeam jobs using stale materials
Added alien costume to the skin viewer

Add test conversation hidden behind admin convar to demo phone conversations
S2P fishing villages

Stop sending some conversation state info with every speech node when we don't need to
Add missing conversation to conversation manifest
scrap king - texture updates
scrap king - collider update
Don't send string keys to format to client unless the current speech node contains that key
Uzi FX & related files.
